statement: At shared source5b7a9d2a9a2638a1251a805d20d31349c35fa904, build004 checks the actual finite-group subset triple deviation |T(S)-s^3/r|<=M*s under explicit nontrivial character-sum bounds M>=0. The curve analytic input remains external: Kohel-Shparlinski for x in characteristic>3 and the interval Fourier L1 bound give M=1+4sqrt(p)(1+ln p). For full prime-order elliptic groups and intervals with s asymptotic to r/b at b=2^(O(sqrt(log2 r))), independent uniform subset inputs return to the same subset with probability asymptotic to 1/b, not near certainty. This assesses that uniform-list closure assumption only; it supplies no general interval-selector lower bound or fast algorithm. All original build failures/source pins and the pre-edit inheritance probe are retained; the canonical full gate is pending.
